name: composer
need: Write a message: a field that grows, attachments as chips, slash commands, mentions, send and stop, drafts

--ds-composer-max-height.description: the tallest the composer's textarea grows before it scrolls

--ds-composer-bg.description: the composer's fill at rest (`--ds-surface` while focus is inside)

--ds-composer-chip-height.description: an attachment chip of the composer at md, comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step)

--ds-composer-chip-max-width.description: the widest name of an attachment chip before its ellipsis

--ds-composer-palette-width.description: the command and mention palette (never wider than the window)

--ds-composer-option-height.description: a palette row at md, comfortable (8px per size step, 4px per density step)

physical..ds-composer__palette: inset: script coordinates: --ds-composer-palette-x from the left of the viewport

ripple..ds-composer__option: focus stays in the field and a press inserts the option and closes the palette; the state layer is the feedback
